display.title: Episode 362: The Return of Yehudah, Chapter 7 (Shabbos Mevarchim Adar I)
display.summary_short: Peter hears a voice in the night: 'Yehudah, you are a Jew.' Plus the Jewish Children's Expo, a Shema guest, a Shiviti sign from New Jersey, and Shabbos Mevarchim Adar I.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi opens with the Jewish Children's Expo, coming to the Javits Center at Rosh Chodesh Adar. After the Hakochainik march, a seven-year-old girl from Beis Rivka leads the Shema; her sister and baby brother listen in too. Story time continues The Return of Yehudah: twelve-year-old Peter wakes in the night crying, having heard a gentle voice say 'Yehudah, you are a Jew; return to your people and your parents.' The poritz dismisses it, but the voice returns the next night, and Peter prays to G-d for an answer. Then an old man with a shining face and a long white beard appears in his dream, tells him his real name, and asks him to come at noon to a cabin by the lake in the forest. In the mailbox, an eight-year-old girl from New Jersey sends a homemade Shiviti sign and letter, and listeners are invited to send theirs. Uncle Yossi explains that this Shabbos, Parshas Mishpatim, is Shabbos Mevarchim for Adar I in a leap year, introduces the new Simcha Club, and gives candle-lighting time and a rank-points offer for signing up friends.
display.lesson: A Jewish soul always longs to return to Hashem and its people; when confused, turn to Hashem in prayer.
